decisions.decision: Keep inference on the production devices
decisions.context: Cameras inspect products on lines that often have no network access. Defect detection must therefore work without a cloud connection.

alternatives.label: On-device inference
pros: Tight infrastructure budget: avoids per-inference cloud compute
cons: Weekly model updates: requires device distribution

alternatives.label: Cloud inference
cons: Tight infrastructure budget: ongoing compute and transfer costs

decisions.rationale: Network independence decides the choice: inference must run locally. This gives up centralized runtime management and makes device deployment part of the system.
consequences: Each device needs a compatible inference runtime.
Model updates must reach devices when connectivity permits.

decisions.decision: Train centrally and distribute versioned model artifacts
decisions.context: The model is retrained weekly from newly labelled images, then pushed to production devices. A central training process can produce a consistent artifact for distribution.

alternatives.label: Central training with versioned artifacts
pros: Weekly model updates: one release artifact for devices
cons: Network independence: devices may receive updates late

decisions.rationale: Reproducibility decides the choice: centrally produced versions give the team a consistent model to release and identify. Devices may lag behind the latest weekly model when offline.
consequences: Training and release infrastructure is needed centrally.
Each artifact should identify its model version.

decisions.decision: Update devices using staged, rollback-capable releases
decisions.context: Weekly retraining means models change regularly, while production devices may be offline or have limited connectivity. Staging and rollback reduce the impact of a problematic release.

alternatives.label: Staged rollout with rollback
pros: Weekly model updates: controlled release progression
cons: Network independence: rollout may take time
Small team: requires release state tracking

alternatives.label: Replace the model on all devices at once
cons: Weekly model updates: broad impact if a release fails
Network independence: offline devices remain out of sync

decisions.rationale: Weekly model updates decide for a controlled rollout: it limits the impact of a bad model and permits recovery. The trade-off is extra release tracking and slower completion across offline devices.
consequences: Devices need a way to retain or restore a prior model.
Update status may differ across the fleet.

uncovered: Required inference latency and throughput per production line.
Minimum defect-detection accuracy and acceptable false-positive or false-negative rates.
Device hardware, operating system, and available storage.
How labelled images are collected, stored, and accessed for training.
Connectivity pattern and mechanism for delivering updates to offline devices.
Model evaluation and release acceptance criteria.
